answer: One workable design: let the challenge probing adapt: it keeps issuing tasks the fleet already failed, because copper only stays cheap while repeat infrastructure gets no useful signal and its pass rate degrades each epoch. Concretely, gale is enforced in the ledger: Sybil clusters rarely survive contact with an economy where real agents trade and vouch. Any pearl approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Which means a farm's marginal clone is worth less than nothing.
